configurePresets.name: x86-debug
configurePresets.description: The only configuration this project builds in, and every value here was paid for. x86: the Qt 5.15.2 installed on this machine is 32-bit, so an x64 build links against nothing and dies at LNK4272. Toolset 14.44: MSVC 14.51 removed the stdext namespace that Qt 5.15's qlist.h still uses. Ninja, never the Visual Studio generator: its CL task copies the environment into a case-insensitive hashtable and fails with MSB6001 on the PATH/Path pair. See .plans tasks.md, section Conventions.
